create_split_coupling_bijector: create a SplitCoupling bijector with a custom conditioner and inner bijector for conditional transformations
forward_split_coupling: compute the forward transformation and log Jacobian determinant of a SplitCoupling bijector on input data
inverse_split_coupling: compute the inverse transformation and log Jacobian determinant of a SplitCoupling bijector on output data
review_split_coupling_swap: review the SplitCoupling bijector swap parameter to toggle which split part remains unchanged during transformation
test_split_coupling_inner_bijector: test the SplitCoupling inner bijector wrapping logic that auto-wraps with Block for extra event dimensions
